items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: There was one guy, an old guy, Rutherford, Al Rutherford... I mean you know the military band... I became the first clarinetist.

ctx.x: Right. I’ll think of that in a moment.

Yeah, yeah, “I Got Rhythm” you know. A twelve inch V-disk. He played that for me and a couple of other things you know. It was very nice. So I had a very good time. And that’s when I started to play jazz. They had sort of a big band, and I didn’t want to play saxophone. I took I think clarinet lessons from the local symphony guy on my own and I didn’t want to play saxophone. I was going to be a legitimate clarinet player. And that’s what I played in the military band, I became the first clarinetist. There was one…
